summary: The recorded base reproduces the reported AttributeError when next_token_token_ids_logprobs_val contains a host list. The exact candidate guards conversion in both the reported prefill path and the duplicated decode normalization path. Its regression passes, and independent mixed host-list/gfx950 tensor cases match a NumPy CPU reference. The candidate changes Python and tests only; it does not change native code.

tests.what_was_measured: At base 358c163250ad3b1f62939b01ce1314a0a31a0365, direct calls to move_logprobs_to_cpu and _normalize_decode_outputs raised AttributeError for host-list and mixed list/tensor values, while the tensor-only control passed. The fixture catches and records each exception, so its process exit is zero.
At exact candidate 8fe83674054f07a8976e1b2b8b0a465a021ce661, all four candidate regressions passed, covering empty host lists, tensor-only values, mixed values, and decode normalization.

On one AMD Instinct MI355X gfx950 GPU, prefill and decode conversion accepted mixed empty/non-empty host lists and real device tensors. Converted float32 values equaled an independent NumPy CPU reference and host-list identity was preserved.
The selected MLX logprob tests were unavailable on this ROCm host: five were skipped and 21 deselected. This is recorded as an architecture limitation, not positive proof.

gpu_execution.evidence: candidate-independent-gpu.txt records AMD Instinct MI355X, gfx950:sramecc+:xnack-, actual device tensors, NumPy reference values, and PASS.

remaining_limitations: No model weights or original server launch/request were supplied, so this review does not claim a full serving/model reproduction, semantic model validation, or distributed execution.
GPU validation used one assigned gfx950 device and a focused scheduler conversion fixture, not a full model.
MLX-specific tests skipped on the ROCm host; MLX architecture behavior was not independently executed.
No native source changed between the recorded base and candidate, so no native rebuild was applicable.

The adjacent next_token_top_logprobs_val/idx conversion still assumes tensor entries. Upstream PR 35052 guards that neighboring field too, but it is not the next_token_token_ids_logprobs_val failure reported in issue 35705.
